name: Thumbnail
promptTemplate:
Create a thumbnail that communicates my idea instantly at small size. Use one strong focal point, clear hierarchy, and brief readable text for the intended context. Preserve supplied details exactly; do not invent names, claims, labels, or additional copy.

Ask for a content image the thumbnail will represent, then ask clarifying questions to required text, audience or context, and visual style. Present relevant thumbnail style directions when available.

exampleImages.alt: Social media post mockup on a pale green background with a person in a white chef jacket taking a mirror selfie and large white text reading one day in my life.
